  \caption{\textbf{Whole-genome CAFA evaluation on all six splits.} Six complete prokaryotic genomes ($20{,}697$ coding sequences) are withheld and annotated as whole chromosomes. Targets are proteins with experimental GOA annotations in the \texttt{truth\_dual} files; the time splits evaluate the $1{,}060$ targets that gained their first experimental annotation after $t_0$, and the homology splits evaluate all $3{,}315$ targets. $f_w$ is the information-accretion-weighted $F_{\max}$ (CAFA IA weights), $F_{\max}$ the protein-centric $F_{\max}$, and $S_{\min}$ the minimum semantic distance, each averaged over MF, BP, and CC. $V$ counts propagated protein--term pairs with a taxon-forbidden term scored at or above $\min(\tau^{*}, 0.25)$, where $\tau^{*}$ is the method's $f_w$-optimal threshold for the aspect; $V_{0.50}$ counts them at a fixed threshold of $0.50$. $h$ is the down-weighting factor of the DeepGOCNN, ESM-2 MLP, and ESM-2 C-HMCNN channels (MF and BP) inside the Stage 0 pool of the GSPA rows, selected on each split's $600$ validation proteins from $\{1.0, 0.75, 0.55, 0.38\}$. The official pretrained DeepFRI and DeepGO-SE models are evaluated on the two time splits only. Source: \texttt{results/cafa\_whole\_genome\_time\_and\_homology\_splits.tsv} (pipeline P01, \texttt{scripts/run\_cafa\_whole\_genome\_splits.py}).}
